Questions about the Travel Demand Model, Real-Estate Market Model or Bike Demand Model, data requests, or help applying our tools to a planning study? Reach the Analytics team directly.

- {{< fa envelope >}} [analytics@wfrc.utah.gov](mailto:analytics@wfrc.utah.gov)

## Found a problem with a tool or this site?

Open an issue in the relevant repository. For this website, use [Report a bug](https://github.com/WFRCAnalytics/wfrcanalytics.github.io/issues/new){target="_blank"} or [Ask a question](https://github.com/WFRCAnalytics/wfrcanalytics.github.io/discussions/new/choose){target="_blank"}. Tool-specific repositories are listed in the [Code catalog](code/index.qmd).

For general information about WFRC programs and services, visit [wfrc.utah.gov](https://wfrc.utah.gov){target="_blank"}.
